metadata.description: Acme Claude Code plugins — global engineering practice, delivery operations, and wiki-resident org skills

plugins.name: agent-skills
plugins.description: Project-agnostic engineering practice and workstation operations: operating principles, scope discipline, TDD, incremental implementation, debugging, code review, security and threat modeling, performance, observability, git workflow, PR lifecycle and shipping; plus disk reclaim, hidden-service discovery, safe repo removal, failing-fleet triage, and cross-source work summaries.

plugins.name: delivery-skills
plugins.description: Acme delivery operations: deploy, cloud-build, qa, npm-publish, triage-dependabot, create-plan, retro, reset and sunset

plugins.name: wiki-skills
plugins.description: Org skills that live beside the decisions they encode — work shaping, repo orientation, story implementation, delivery review, interface design and theme audit, release readiness, decision records, trust posture, mail authentication records, capture teardown, wiki ingest and lint

plugins.name: crm-skills
plugins.description: Projection of the Acme company brain into Twenty CRM — schema reconciliation against registries/crm-schema.yaml, brain-to-Twenty record sync on brainSlug, and dated read-back snapshots that exclude third-party personal data by role
